name: sound_chain
description: Edit mImageViewer (mIV) Sound. Needs mIV Read + settings access. Explain first; user-requested edits only. lock -> get -> apply/select/undo/save_preset -> unlock; writes need lock, apply/select latest revision. User may force unlock. get also unlocked: pipeline gives <=32 stages from offset, next_offset continues; ids <=8 gives parameters. apply replaces pipeline: {id} retains, id+type patches, no id adds; omitted stages removed, IDs belong to that pipeline. Check keys: sound_effects; no new external assets. select: use A/B, bypass bool. Build in B leaving A to compare; after unlock return via lock/select A. undo: last apply/select once in SAME lock; unavailable after unlock. save_preset needs pipeline/name <=64 chars, adds MCP: prefix; replace only MCP: presets, cannot undo replacement. Accepted before DSP rebuild; even B edits cut active tails. High latency may stop Sound until mIV restart; heavy chains may stutter. Details: get_help ai-integration.html#sound.
